transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi, I'd like to book a cleaning with Dr. Patel on Tuesday, March 3 at 2:30 PM.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect, Dr. Patel will see you Tuesday then, same time we discussed.

transcript.speaker: agent

failures.why_hard: The booking promise exists only in the transcript. The rules look for a booking verb and a parseable date and time in the same sentence. Resolving “same time we discussed” requires looking back to an earlier caller turn.
